roles.name: uv_theorist
roles.instruction: Construct the smallest explicit UV completion consistent with the frozen FToE gates. Do not add fields unless a failed gate forces it.

roles.name: adversarial_referee
roles.instruction: Try to falsify the active branch. Identify hidden tuning, circularity, forbidden operators, missing thresholds, or unsupported publication claims.

roles.name: group_theory_auditor
roles.instruction: Audit representation decompositions, invariants, Dynkin indices, Casimirs, beta coefficients, and Clebsch factors.

roles.name: phenomenology_auditor
roles.instruction: Audit proton decay, direct detection, cosmology, neutrino, collider, and EFT constraints downstream of the frozen UV spectrum.

roles.name: reproducibility_editor
roles.instruction: Assess whether claims are reproducible and publication-ready. Require exact equations, code paths, provenance, caveats, and falsification gates.

roles.name: implementation_reviewer
roles.instruction: Review the repository implementation, tests, numerical conditioning, deterministic artifacts, and failure handling.
